messages.content: Could you please find the nearest weather stations for the following points: 34.0522, -118.2437, 40.7128, -74.0060, 51.5074, -0.1278, and 35.6895, 139.6917?

function.name: Get_Nearest_Weather_Stations
function.description: Retrieve weather stations nearest to a given point in order of distance.

function.name: Current_Conditions_Basic
function.description: Retrieves basic current weather conditions for a given latitude and longitude.

longitude.description: The longitude of the location for which to retrieve current weather conditions.

latitude.description: The latitude of the location for which to retrieve current weather conditions.

function.name: dailyWeatherSeries
function.description: This endpoint returns the historical weather data for a given series of days for a given location (latitude and longitude).

lat.description: The latitude in decimal format of the requested point

lng.description: The longitude in decimal format of the requested point

start_day.description: The requested start day in the format YYYYmmdd

end_day.description: The requested end day in the format YYYYmmdd

parameters.description: Define the parameter, you wish to request. Allowed options are all, air_quality, anomaly, astronomy, weather, signal, pollen, occurrence

function.name: Current_Air_Quality_API
function.description: Retrieves current air quality data for a specified city or location.

function.name: Hourly_Forecast_API
function.description: Returns the hourly weather forecast for a given ski resort

resort.description: The name of the ski resort

el.description: Specify a part of the mountain. Accepted values are 'top', 'mid', and 'bot'. Using this parameter improves response time.

units.description: Specify desired units. Accepted values are 'i' (imperial) and 'm' (metric). Using this parameter improves response time.

c.description: Limit result to current day only
